item.title: AI Chip High-Speed Interconnect Solutions
item.description: I have been studying the infrastructure around model training lately, and I found that AI chip interconnect topology determines the scheduling and resource allocation of training cluster jobs. So I spent a little time putting together the common AI chip interconnect solutions. 1. Point-to-Point Interconnect In a traditional PCIe system, data transfer between AI chips goes over PCIe, which cannot meet the demands of large-scale data transfer.
